interview_instructions: Conduct an interview with Sally Ann Smith, a witness to a robbery of a liquor store, that occurred on the corner of Johnson and College Streets three days ago. When you begin the interview, a transcript of the interview will appear on-screen. When you end the interview, you’ll have the option to export the transcript as a Microsoft Word file.

facts_to_provide.fact: I was walking home down Johnson Street towards the intersection with College at 5.30pm
facts_to_provide.reason: Clear memory of routine walk home from work

facts_to_provide.fact: I saw a man run into the Wine O'Clock bottle store wearing a mask and holding a knife
facts_to_provide.reason: Clearly witnessed from 300 metres away, distinctive threatening appearance

facts_to_provide.fact: He had a mask on, black sweatshirt, blue jeans and white trainers and carried a small backpack
facts_to_provide.reason: Good view of clothing details before he entered store

facts_to_provide.fact: I heard screaming and the sound of glass breaking coming from the corner bottle store
facts_to_provide.reason: Loud sounds clearly audible from street

facts_to_provide.fact: I was about 300 metres away and saw the man run out of the store, towards me
facts_to_provide.reason: Estimated distance based on familiar street layout

facts_to_provide.fact: He ran past on the other side of the road and took his mask off as he ran past
facts_to_provide.reason: Direct line of sight as he ran past, saw mask removal clearly

facts_to_provide.fact: He was white, a shaved head and black moustache. Height 5 feet 5 inches and ages mid-20's
facts_to_provide.reason: Got clear view of face after mask removal, close enough to assess features

facts_to_provide.fact: He ran down Philip's lane and emerged in a light grey Mazda2 with no licence plates
facts_to_provide.reason: Followed his path visually, familiar with car models, noticed missing plates

facts_to_provide.fact: He drove away from the intersection and drove away at speed
facts_to_provide.reason: Watched him drive off, clearly driving fast

facts_to_provide.fact: I called 111, checked on the store owner, left my details and then had to get home to cook
facts_to_provide.reason: Remembers exact sequence of actions after incident
